name: GovInfo
summary: The US Government Publishing Office's GovInfo API: official publications of all three branches (bills, Congressional Record, Federal Register, CFR, court opinions, public laws) with search, change lists, package and granule metadata and related documents.

api_key.description: api.data.gov key (free sign-up at https://www.govinfo.gov/api-signup); DEMO_KEY works with a much lower limit. Sent as the api_key query parameter.

notes: Rate limits per key (rolling hour): 36,000 requests per hour, 1,200 per minute, 40 per second; 429 when over. DEMO_KEY is far lower.
Lists page with offsetMark: send '*' first, then follow the nextPage value in each response. pageSize is required on list calls, at most 1000. The older offset parameter is deprecated.
Collection codes (BILLS, CREC, FR, CFR, PLAW, USCOURTS, CHRG, ...) come from collections.list.

A package or granule summary links to its content (htm, xml, pdf, mods, premis, zip). A first request for a ZIP or MODS file may return 503 with Retry-After: 30 while it is generated; retry after the delay.

endpoints.name: Search GovInfo
endpoints.summary: Full-text search across GovInfo with the same query syntax as the GovInfo website.

query.description: Search query in GovInfo syntax; field operators like collection:(USCOURTS) are allowed.

offsetMark.description: '*' for the first page, then the offsetMark the previous response gave.

sorts.description: List of {field, sortOrder}. Supported fields: score (DESC only), publishdate, lastModified, title (ASC or DESC).

resultLevel.description: Level of detail of each result.

endpoints.name: List collections
endpoints.summary: Every GovInfo collection with its code, name and package and granule counts.

endpoints.name: List packages added or changed in a collection
endpoints.summary: Package ids in one collection added or modified since a date-time, for tracking updates.

collection.description: Collection code, e.g. BILLS, CREC, FR, PLAW, USCOURTS.

lastModifiedStartDate.description: Start of the lastModified window, ISO 8601 yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'.

offsetMark.description: '*' first, then the value from nextPage.

docClass.description: Collection-specific category, e.g. bill type (s, hr) in BILLS or section (HOUSE, SENATE) in CREC.

notes: lastModified is when GovInfo added or updated the package, not the publication date; use published.list for publication dates.
For an end date too, call /collections/{collection}/{start}/{end} raw.

endpoints.name: List packages by publication date
endpoints.summary: Packages in the given collections issued between two dates.

offsetMark.description: '*' first, then the value from nextPage.

docClass.description: Collection-specific category, e.g. bill type in BILLS.

modifiedSince.description: Only packages modified since this ISO 8601 date-time.

endpoints.name: Get a package summary
endpoints.summary: Metadata of one package and links to every content and metadata format (text, XML, PDF, MODS, ZIP).

endpoints.name: List a package's granules
endpoints.summary: The granules (sections, articles, hearings parts) of one package, with titles, ids and summary links.

offsetMark.description: '*' first, then the value from nextPage.

endpoints.name: Get a granule summary
endpoints.summary: Metadata of one granule and links to its content and metadata formats.

endpoints.name: List related documents
endpoints.summary: Relationships of a package or granule: bill versions, history, public laws, reports, CFR citations and more.
notes: Each relationship links to /related/{accessId}/{collection} for the related documents in that collection.
